## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Esoteric *dhāraṇī* scripture translated by **Bodhiruci II** 菩提流志 ([菩提流志](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E5%BF%97), 572?–727?), the great Tang Indian-pilgrim translator at the Wǔ-Zhōu / Kāiyuán courts. The text presents a *Buddha-heart* (*fóxīn* 佛心) doctrinal-Esoteric scripture in the *dhāraṇī*-class tradition.

**Abstract**

The *Fóxīn jīng* presents a doctrinal-Esoteric scripture organised around the *Buddha-heart* concept — the cosmic-essence of all Buddhas as their unitary "heart" (*hṛdaya*). The two-fascicle structure covers the doctrinal exposition and the *dhāraṇī*-recitation practice. The translation dates from Bodhiruci's documented Chángān period (693–727).
